Linn Mercy keeps its eight-two Colonial majority, Warden dead running well ahead about Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Mooring County's flare at The Wind Hills carries into the evening, Colonial losses there outpacing Warden. Callahans Passage, second-busiest at our last press, has cooled markedly, while Callums Cape and the Dead Lands quicken sharply in the latest hour. Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf stay quiet on flags. It is day 745; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.

colonial_reinforce.reason: The Wind Hills was captured only ~25 minutes before cutoff and has changed hands more than a dozen times in the event log; Colonial casualty rates in Mooring just spiked (483/hr, +443 vs prior window), so garrisoning and building here is needed to make the capture stick against the obvious Warden counter.

colonial_attack.reason: Outwich Ranch is a Warden-held Town Base I in the eastern LinnMercy corridor that has already flipped three times in 24h; Wardens are bleeding heavily region-wide (1620/hr, +1287 change), so an immediate Colonial counter at this thin, freshly taken base is the cheapest recapture available.

warden_reinforce.reason: Outwich Ranch is the Wardens' newest gain (17:21Z) in a corridor they lost twice today; reinforcing it converts the LinnMercy push into a stable line rather than another flip, while Warden casualties in the region are the packet's highest and the push cannot absorb another reversal.

warden_attack.reason: Blinding Stones fell to the Colonials at 17:36Z as part of a three-base Nevish sweep; Warden casualty rates in Nevish are the packet's highest (1680/hr, +1187 change), indicating a major Warden commitment already in the region, so striking this just-flipped relic before the Colonials consolidate is the best reversal window.

war_summary: Afternoon returns show the Weathered Expanse ablaze again after its morning lull, with six movements in two hours and sixty-three on the day about Spirit Watch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest for five Colonial, one Warden and three ruined holdings, last heard at 1736, while day losses of 5,313 Colonial and 6,937 Warden quicken. The Nevish Line remains contested with two in two hours and forty-five on the day about Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones and Tomb Father for four holdings apiece, last at 1736, with day losses near 8,447 Colonial and 9,427 Warden still accelerating. Linn Mercy reports three in two hours and forty on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for eight Colonial, two Warden and one ruined holding, last at 1721, losses sharply accelerating. Mooring County stirs with three in two hours and twenty-five on the day at the Wind Hills, last at 1736. Stonecradle has gone quiet in two hours after six in six, last at 1431, and Marban Hollow silent since 0346, while Callahan's Passage records heavy but easing losses with no transfer.

colonial_attack.reason: Warden-owned Lathair has flipped repeatedly and Warden casualties are spiking, indicating sustained Colonial pressure worth continuing.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Colonial-owned The Wind Hills flips almost hourly and Colonial losses surged in last 2h, so it needs holding to stop immediate recapture.

warden_attack.reason: Colonial-owned Blinding Stones just flipped from Wardens and intense 1h casualty surge shows active contest Wardens should press to retake.

warden_reinforce.reason: Warden-owned Outwich Ranch was just recaptured after repeated neutral periods and regional fighting remains intense, so it needs consolidation.
